name: Detroit Woodworking
old_description: Detroit Woodworking specializes in custom residential woodworking, collaborating with homeowners, architects, and designers to create handcrafted cabinetry, intricate moldings, and custom furniture with exceptional attention to detail. Serving Grosse Pointe and Metro Detroit, we blend traditional and modern design using premium materials to craft durable, inviting spaces while ensuring a seamless experience from consultation to installation.
about:
Detroit Woodworking is a family-owned millwork and cabinetry shop based in Roseville, Michigan, serving the metro Detroit area and shipping nationwide. The company was founded on a commitment to traditional craftsmanship combined with modern manufacturing technology, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop operates a state-of-the-art production facility equipped with CNC machining, laser engraving, and professional finishing systems. Its capabilities span custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, custom doors, live-edge furniture, conference tables, healthcare and educational casework, specialty fabrication, and prototype or one-off projects. The team handles projects from design engineering and 3D rendering through material selection, manufacturing, finishing, and installation, with typical production timelines of eight to twelve weeks.

Detroit Woodworking serves a diverse client base including homeowners, architects, designers, developers, and corporations across industries such as hospitality, restaurants, retail, healthcare, education, multi-family housing, residential construction, and corporate environments. Projects range from luxury residential kitchens and built-ins to commercial fixtures, displays, and large-scale replicable millwork programs.

The company differentiates itself through a design-build approach that integrates dedicated project management, white-glove delivery, climate-controlled storage, and a limited lifetime warranty on all custom cabinetry and millwork. As one of the few Detroit-area shops with a state-of-the-art laser engraving machine, it can incorporate intricate detailing into both residential and commercial pieces.
